children: Equinor ASA Sponsored ADR (OSL:EQNR) is expanding its fuel and LNG footprint—signing its first long‑term LNG deal with PTT Trading/PTT International while targeting ~7 Mtpa LNG by 2030, growing production at Bacalhau, supplying Sverdrup crude to Orlen and continuing share buybacks and fuel sales.
: Equinor ASA Sponsored ADR (EQNR) signed a long-term LNG supply deal with Thailand’s PTT Trading/PTT International, marking their first long-term LNG contract; commercial terms are confidential.
: Equinor ASA ADR (EQNR) ongoing 2026 buybacks: third tranche runs through Oct 26. Sept repurchases: 683,570 shares at NOK 406.9977 and 379,361 at NOK 419.1253; total own shares 19,798,825 (0.83%).
: Equinor (EQNR) says LNG capacity should double to ~7 Mtpa by 2030. Half current supply comes from Hammerfest; expansion plans may add U.S., Canada, South America and other African sources.
: Equinor's Bacalhau field off Brazil is producing near its 220,000 barrels/day plateau and is expected to reach that level later this year, CEO Anders Opedal said in Oslo.
: Equinor ASA Sponsored ADR (EQNR) will supply Sverdrup crude to Orlen under a signed deal, covering about 25% of Orlen's crude needs; Equinor named as supplier.
E5 Gasoline Sale To Major Traders
: Equinor ASA ADR (EQNR) sold 10,000 metric tons of E5 gasoline in Northwest Europe to Gunvor, Varo, Aramco and Vitol; reported margins for the grade rose to about $52/ barrel.
